description: This Java class 'ServiceUtil' provides utility methods for handling service responses, security checks, message formatting, and service parameter setup within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for handling service responses, security, messaging, and parameter setup within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates an error.

methods.name: isFailure
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates failure.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates success (neither error nor failure).

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Creates a result map indicating an error with a message.

methods.name: returnFailure
methods.description: Creates a result map indicating failure with a message.

methods.name: returnProblem
methods.description: Constructs a detailed result map with response type, messages, and nested errors.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Creates a success result map with optional message(s).

methods.name: returnMessage
methods.description: Builds a result map with response code and message.

methods.name: getPartyIdCheckSecurity
methods.description: Performs security validation based on partyId and permissions.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets error and event messages into an HTTP request.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and formats messages from service results into an HTTP request.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts error messages from service result map.

methods.name: makeErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats error messages from result map with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeSuccessMessage
methods.description: Formats success messages from result map with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeMessageList
methods.description: Concatenates a list of messages with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: addErrors
methods.description: Extracts error messages from a call result and adds them to target list and map.

methods.name: genericDateCondition
methods.description: Checks date range conditions and returns a boolean reply.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves user login info, optionally for a different user.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Gets locale from context or defaults.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Creates a context map from key-value pairs.

methods.name: setServiceFields
methods.description: Prepares service input parameters, including security and validation.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns resource string identifier.
